kitDescription: Pepper is a Wind shotgun Supporter with a Burst I skill on a 20-second cooldown. Each time she fires the last bullet of her magazine, she heals the ally with the lowest HP percentage and applies Refresh Heart to the whole team, a stackable incoming-healing buff that builds to 5 stacks. Her skill 2 periodically damages the enemy with the highest attack and lowers that enemy's attack for 5 seconds. Her burst deals heavy damage to the highest-attack enemy, adds one stack to every stackable buff her allies hold, and — once Refresh Heart is fully stacked — heals the entire team. In game terms she is a magazine-cycling healer whose burst becomes a full-team heal once her passive has ramped up.

verdictRationale: No undocumented gotcha exists: all seven kit lines are FAITHFUL or DOCUMENTED_GAP, and every FAITHFUL line fires at its prose-implied cadence with a RED counterfactual pin (17/17 driver verify GREEN; S5 blind suite 13-pass/3-legit-skip/0-fail GREEN unmodified against the shipped override). The blinds' divergences are blind-side under-models, not driver errors: S6 guessed interval:20 where the datamined skillCooldownsSec gives 10s, and S6 shipped an unconditional burst heal claiming the max-stack gate inexpressible where the driver's resourceGate{refreshHeart≥5} matches the prose and has repo precedent; S2b independently derived the same dispositions the driver landed, including the load-bearing stack machinery. The one substantive residual is the documented gauge-per-shot data gap (pepper missing her datamined 4500/9000 row, ~2.2× gauge undervaluation) — a data backfill for the owner, not a kit-encoding fault and out of magnitude-gated scope. Same-model residual for owner spot-check: the Refresh Heart no-lapse approximation (⚑3), the interval first-fire phase convention t=10 (⚑2, worth exactly one proc), and the kit-■-order interpretation that the burst's +1 increment lands before the gate reads the pool (pinned at the 4-mag cast but an ordering reading, not a measured fact). Nothing here blocks GO.
